notes.title: CHILDREN OF THE CORN & UPDATE
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32677179/9a35e271d88d0114f5d744405ad2b76380df746b.png[/img]

Dears, Hello!

We are glad to say that today you could play new game mode
"CHILDREN OF THE CORN". It is recommended to play with your Best Friend;)
Soon we will post little guide to community hub.

And today an update to "The Great Race" has been released. The update will be applied automatically when you restart Steam client. The major changes include:
[list]
    [*]Several fixes in UI
    [*]Second Player can be removed via second press A on gamepad
    [*]Removed some bugs which provoked crashes
    [*]Achievement "Collector" was very difficult and has been splitted into 6 different achievements: one achievement per token
    [*]Achievement for new game mode was added
[/list]

Please fill free to comment what do you think about new game mode.

Sincerely



P.S. The game is still in Beta, so  if you will have some issues with game please let us know and we will fix problems as fast as it can be done.

Thank you!;)
